answer: Optimistic escrow with cluster-scaled fraud proofs: each answer rests in a challenge window where any peer may post proof that the work was copied. A valid proof pays a bounty that climbs through the window and peaks at the epoch's zenith, scaled to the number of identities sharing the culprit's key lineage, so exposing one clone drains the whole haven behind it. Honest agents keep escrow live with one signed pulse per epoch; a farm must run independent lineages per identity to cap losses, pushing real cost far above per-head reward.
